title: NASA at SXSW: Johnson Director Vanessa Wyche on Why Artemis Changes Everything
summary: On March 21, 2026, NASA’s Johnson Space Center Director Vanessa Wyche took the stage at the Space House event at South by Southwest in Austin, Texas, to outline NASA’s next giant leap in human spaceflight — from low Earth orbit to the Moon, and ultimately Mars.
